elevation.label: Floor Elevation
elevation.hint: Absolute floor height in scene units.

climbPreset.label: Climb terrain
climbPreset.hint: Choose the closest sample task; custom DC takes precedence.

climbDC.label: Custom Climb DC
climbDC.hint: Optional override. Existing region DCs remain readable until replaced.

grabEdgeDC.label: Grab an Edge DC
grabEdgeDC.hint: Optional override; otherwise uses the Climb DC.

swimPreset.label: Water conditions
swimPreset.hint: Calm water normally needs no roll. Unspecified terrain asks the GM.

swimDC.label: Custom Swim DC
swimDC.hint: Optional override, including a check in calm water.

extent.label: Material extent
extent.hint: Unknown asks for a ruling. Solid continues downward; finite has an authored underside.

underside.label: Underside elevation
underside.hint: Absolute feet; must be below the floor top. Leave blank for solid or unknown.

blocksSight.label: Blocks sight
blocksSight.hint: Desired native surface restriction; configure managed visibility to apply.

blocksLight.label: Blocks light
blocksLight.hint: Desired native surface restriction; sound is edited separately.
